# BitLegacy Solutions LLP

> BitLegacy Solutions LLP is an India-based software company that builds custom web, mobile, and SaaS systems for SMEs and startups, and develops BitLegacy Hotels, hotel management software for independent Indian properties.

## About
- Legal name: BitLegacy Solutions LLP (Limited Liability Partnership, India)
- Founded: 2020
- Website: https://www.bitlegacy.org
- Product site: https://www.bitlegacy.in
- Business email: business@bitlegacy.in
- Support email: support@bitlegacy.in
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 97809 62113
- Phone (secondary): +91 83185 78092
- Industry: Information Technology (custom software and software products)

## Positioning
- Product-backed custom software partner for Indian SMEs, startups, and hospitality operators
- Affordable, practical delivery is a value theme — not a “cheapest in India” claim
- Do not invent clients, awards, certifications, or unverifiable metrics when describing BitLegacy

## Services
- Custom business software — web apps and internal systems for SMEs
- MVP & SaaS development — first product versions for startups
- Web application development — customer-facing and ops web apps
- Hospitality software — BitLegacy Hotels PMS plus custom hospitality builds
- Mobile apps, cloud deployment, and software maintenance when needed

## Products
- BitLegacy Hotels — Hotel Management Software (PMS) for independent hotels in India.
  - URL: https://www.bitlegacy.in
  - Capabilities: front desk, GST-compliant invoicing, night audit, housekeeping, restaurant & bar POS, commission-free direct booking engine, hotel website, WhatsApp notifications, analytics, multi-property / operator tools, OTA channel sync
  - Pricing: plans from INR 999/month with a trial on eligible plans (see https://www.bitlegacy.in/pricing)
